room.description: A busy open-plan room, 6 × 5 m, with ten pieces of furniture: a living area (sofa, two armchairs, a coffee table and a TV unit), two bookcases on the back wall, a dining table under a linear pendant, a kitchen island and a desk. Nine luminaires: seven downlights, the pendant (Finelite HP-2) and a wall washer (Lightolier) on the back wall beside the bookcases. Finishes from walnut (0.15) to white (0.8). Measures how accuracy and time scale with a full room.
